verdict.rationale: Riskified documents maintained platform integrations beyond raw API: a dedicated Shopify app with automated order actions (docs-11,12,21,22), a Salesforce Commerce Cloud/Agentforce Commerce fraud cartridge (docs-10), and automated Chargeback Gateway Integration with major PSPs (Braintree, Stripe, Adyen, PayPal) (docs-4,16,17). However, there is no mention of a BigCommerce integration, and the PSP integrations are scoped to chargeback data only rather than full checkout/decisioning flows. Missing for 10: explicit BigCommerce integration, evidence of maintained PSP integrations beyond chargebacks (e.g., payment/checkout-time connectors), independent confirmation of integration quality/maintenance cadence.
